text.en: Pavement design is mainly about the road surface material being hard/tough enough; what's underneath the surface course doesn't matter much -- in reality, pavement is engineered as a layered system specifically to spread a vehicle's concentrated wheel load out over a wide enough area of the underlying soil that it doesn't exceed that soil's bearing capacity.
text.et: Katendi projekteerimine seisneb peamiselt selles, et teepinna materjal oleks piisavalt kõva/vastupidav; mis on pealiskihi all, ei ole eriti oluline -- tegelikult on katend projekteeritud kihilise süsteemina spetsiaalselt selleks, et jaotada sõiduki kontsentreeritud rattakoormus piisavalt laiale aluspinnase alale, et see ei ületaks selle pinnase kandevõimet.
